post_subline: Tap I Am Lost and every rider in your group is notified. They get directions to you.
caption:
Turned around in the bowls after dark? Tap I Am Lost.
Every rider in your group is notified with directions to you. No signal? The alert goes out as soon as you have it.
The app also tells you what to do while you wait, with OHVEST and 911 one tap away.
Free on the App Store. Link in bio.
